name: Spanish
notes: Around 500 million native speakers across Spain and most of the Americas. Spelling is almost perfectly phonetic — once you learn the five vowel sounds you can pronounce any written word correctly, which makes it one of the fastest languages for an English speaker to become useful in.
syllabus: About 920 words and phrases — all of CEFR A1 and A2 (around 1,000 words): the three past tenses, the future and conditional, commands and comparisons, and the vocabulary of work, study, money, travel, the house, the land, tools, animals and the town. A2 means you can handle everyday situations and tell someone what happened. Cards can be spoken aloud if Windows has a Spanish voice installed. Next would be B1.
